Article 5 (Designation of Conflict Management Research Institutions)
(1) The head of the Office for National Affairs Coordination may designate one or more research institutions or organizations as conflict management research institutions (hereinafter referred to as "research institutions") in accordance with Article 24(1) of the Act. <Amended July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013>
(2) When designating research institutions in accordance with paragraph (1), the designation of the research institutions must be published in the official gazette, and announced through the Office for National Affairs Coordination website or domestic newspapers. <Amended July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013>
